messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — Exec Roundtable next Wed 9:30am PT (all-hands format). Goal: one tight sync to share launch callouts, a brief incident recap, and the updated security/data policy. Please skim the agenda below and drop any talking points or questions by EOD Friday.

Jordan: Agenda (short + focused):
```
1) Launch highlights — Product (5m)
2) Incident recap — Eng SRE (5m)
3) Policy changes: data retention & access — Security/Legal (10m)
4) Roadmap Q&A — Execs (20m)
5) Feedback & close (5m)
```

Jordan: Logistics: 30m total + 5m buffer. Recording will be posted to #all-hands-recordings within 24h. Calendar invite sent — please RSVP. Pre-read (short bullets) and slide deck links coming by Monday.

Anna: Quick question — can we nudge to 10:00am PT so APAC folks can join?

Jordan: I hear you — we need the window for US coverage. We'll keep it recorded and add a 5-min timezone-friendly recap after the meeting. If there are items that need real-time APAC input, drop them in the form and we'll surface them live.

Sam: I'll do the incident recap. Will post a 2-paragraph postmortem + timeline beforehand (ETA Mon). Link to draft: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-incident-draft

Sam: :thumbsup:

Jia: I can handle launch highlights — prepping a 5-slide summary and key metrics. Will upload slides by Mon EOD.

Leo: For the policy section, is Security + Legal confirmed? tagging Maria to confirm attendees.

Maria: Confirmed. Security and Legal will join and we'll bring a TL;DR doc + FAQ. TL;DR link: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-policy-tldr

Kumar: Is there a dedicated place to drop questions so they don't get lost in threads?

Jordan: Yes — please either reply in this thread or use the intake form: https://forms.gle/redwood-exec-roundtable-qa. We'll triage questions ahead of time and call out which ones we'll answer live.

ops-bot: Event created: "Exec Roundtable" — 2026-04-14 16:30 UTC — invite sent to @all-hands.ics. (Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3632104987)

Anna: Thanks — I'll add a handful of customer-impact questions to the form.

Jia: Heads-up: will include two quick A/B perf slides for Dedicated vs Hosted to show cost impact (1 slide).

Jordan: Perfect. Keep slides minimal — 3 slides max per presenter. Pre-reads + deck links will be posted by Monday. If anyone needs more than 3 slides, ping me directly.

Leo: I'll drop the policy FAQ into the docs repo and link it here once done.

Maria: Also prepping a short migration checklist for teams impacted by the retention change. Will share by Tue.

Jordan: Thanks everyone — appreciate keeping this tight. Looking forward to an actionable session. If you can't make it live, we'll capture the Qs and record.
